name: Runemaster audit: Unbound shortens an incoming Curse-dispel debuff's duration by 20% (#3654)
contract: EffectBasePoints -21 + DieSides 1 = -20%; effect 1 is the same aura for EffectMiscValue 1 (DISPEL_MAGIC),
spellProto->Dispel) for incoming harmful auras. Curse of Weakness (702) has Dispel 2 (DISPEL_CURSE) and a
120000ms base duration (SpellDuration 4) - long enough to observe a clean 20% cut with no CoA script needed.
Verification note: WorldSession::HandleCancelAuraOpcode (SpellHandler.cpp:605) refuses to remove a non-
positive aura ('don't allow remove non positive spells') - Curse of Weakness is harmful, so the client-style
cancel_aura action silently no-ops on it. This uses set_aura with stacks 0 (Unit::RemoveAurasDueToSpell, no
positivity check) to clear the curse between the two casts instead. The NPC caster receives native spell
accuracy, and each native NPC Curse must actually apply before its duration is observed. The original
duration and exact twenty-percent reduction bounds remain unchanged.

steps.label: The real NPC caster has native spell accuracy before duration observations
The curse is actually applied before measuring its duration
Clear the curse (cancel_aura refuses non-positive auras)
The curse is actually applied before measuring its duration
Curse of Weakness duration is cut ~20% (0.75-0.85)
